{"steps":[{"name":"Skin test for beard color (a small test for a reaction to hair dye)","when":"at least 48 hours before beard or hair color, the time the dye's label sets","who":"new color clients, and anyone whose last test has run out","goodFor":"3 months (the example shop's rule), or until the dye changes","result":"the barber checks the spot before mixing any color; redness or itching calls the color off, with no fee"}],"reaction":"a past reaction to hair dye: the booking waits for Sam's OK, and the skin test comes first","prep":"for the reminder: bring a photo of the style if you have one; for a house call, a chair near an outlet and good light","away":"none for house calls or events: color stays at the shop"}

{"checkIn":"at the shop: the check-in code at the chair or the front desk; a walk-in gets a code when he's next; at a home or venue: the code from whoever will be there (the groom or the venue contact when a mobile is given for them)","beforeWork":"the barber goes over the reference photo, the guard numbers and the beard first, and checks the skin before a razor or color","changes":"anything added at the chair (a beard trim, a line-up) is priced and OK'd before it's done; booked customers go first, and a walk-in starts only if it fits before the next booking","done":"the check-in code, or DONE from the barber; guard numbers, the style and any skin-test date go in the barber's notes for next time"}

{"before":"at the shop: a card saved for the $20 fee, and paid at the chair (the Groom's package takes a $40 deposit when booked); a home or office visit: a card saved for the $89 fee; a groom's cut at home is paid in full when booked; a wedding party: a 25% deposit when booked","caps":"deposit cap: from the state form","cancel":"free to cancel until 24 hours before (the owner's setting; many barbershops pick 2 hours for a cut)","fees":"late cancel or no-show: $20 at the shop ($40 for the Groom's package); $89 for a home or office visit; a wedding party: the deposit may be kept, never more. Sam confirms each fee, never more than what was paid now or agreed; no card and no deposit, no fee","repeat":"after 2 no-shows or late cancels with no card, the shop can ask that customer for a card to book (the owner's setting)","refunds":"a full refund if the shop changes the plan, or a skin test rules color out","tips":"on: at the chair (the reader or cash), or a tip line on the bill Rosie texts; tips go to the barber","tax":"a tax line for products sold, where the state's rules require it","fee2":"Rosfield's $2 applies"}

{"never":"dye-reaction, skin-test and skin or scalp answers never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record; the customer never hears why a barber is out","photos":"a reference photo only on the secure page; the barber sees it by private link","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"a minor's booking texts go to the parent or guardian"}

{"licenses":"each barber's license per state; skin care where the state licenses it","skills":"cuts, fades, beard work, razor shaves, kids cuts, beard color, house calls and events; only barbers who do color are offered for beard color","supervision":"apprentices and students work only under a licensed barber, where the state's rules allow","oks":"Sam OKs a group of 3 or more at the shop, a booking after a past dye reaction, and any wedding party quote over $500","standIn":"a barber out: another barber who does that service, at the same time and price; the stand-in gets the cut notes","away":"only barbers cleared for work away from the shop are offered for house calls and events","booth":"a booth renter's bookings are their own, never sent to the shop's owner"}

{"showLicense":"each barber's license and the shop's posted where the state's rules require it; the license number in texts where the state asks","away":"barbering away from the shop only where the state allows it, and only for the services it allows (a switch from the state form)","booth":"booth rental only where the state allows it; a renter's license or a written agreement where the state's rules require one","receipt":"what a receipt must show, where the state's rules require it","minors":"a parent's written OK for color on a minor, where the state's rules require it","records":"skin-test dates and cut notes kept with the customer's record: 7 years, or longer where the state asks","contracts":"a signed contract for wedding party work (the owner's setting), and where the state's rules require one above an amount"}
